verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs say you can build funnels and paths insights on the events you already send. PostHog AI, an in-product analyst, takes plain-English questions, queries the data, builds the insight and explains what it found, which lets a founder answer activation questions without an analyst. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of step-by-step drop-off and conversion breakdowns in funnels, and independent or hands-on corroboration of founders doing this self-serve.
